    x = tf.constant(v, dtype=tf.float64)
    return float(tf.reduce_sum(tf.square(tf.nn.silu(x))))
base = np.array([[0.3, -0.7, 0.5], [0.2, 0.9, -0.4]])
x = tf.Variable(tf.constant(base, dtype=tf.float64))
with tf.GradientTape() as tape:
    y = tf.reduce_sum(tf.square(tf.nn.silu(x)))
g = tape.gradient(y, x)
g = g.numpy().ravel().tolist()
worst = 0.0
flat = base.ravel()
for i in range(6):
    p = flat.copy()
    p[i] += 1e-6
    q = flat.copy()
    q[i] -= 1e-6
    n = (f(p.reshape(2, 3)) - f(q.reshape(2, 3))) / 2e-6
    worst = max(worst, abs(n - g[i]))
print(worst)
